records.text: Candace Owens says she thinks Steven Crowder knew he was distributing 'Fed slop' and that his access to leaked shooting materials was not accidental.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: When someone leaked the info about the bullets being inscribed with trans stuff to Steven Crowder the day after the 10th, do you think that he was just a useful idiot, or do you think he knew he was shoveling out the Fed slop? I think he knew he was ... it just keeps falling into Steven Crowder's lap in the same way that TMZ just kind of gets these things, and you wonder. Okay, like I said, I'm just here to recognize patterns, and I do not think that that was an accident at all.

verification.notes: The claim that Steven Crowder knowingly spread 'Fed slop' and that a shooting-material leak was not accidental asserts knowledge and intent. Current court and investigative reporting addresses the evidence and public theories but does not establish Crowder's private knowledge or an intentional leak.

records.text: Candace Owens said Stephen 'tWitch' Boss's autopsy found no drugs or alcohol, motel staff said he showed no distress and no one heard gunfire, and investigators concluded suicide after a note alluded to past challenges
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And an autopsy report confirmed, this is what's crucial, that there were no drugs or alcohol that was found in his system at the time of death. ... TMZ then went around and spoke to motel staffers who said that he didn't appear to be in any sort of distress. ... the staffers also said that no one even heard the gunfire at any point during his stay ... according to law enforcement and multiple news reports he left a note alluding to past challenges and led investigators to conclude that the death must have been a suicide

verification.notes: The Los Angeles Times reports negative toxicology, a note alluding to past challenges, and the suicide determination; TMZ reports motel staff saw no visible distress and heard no gunfire. Together the current sources support each component of the citation statement.

sources.title: Stephen 'tWitch' Boss' autopsy report sheds new light on details of his death
sources.relevance: Supports toxicology, note, and suicide determination.

sources.title: DJ Stephen 'tWitch' Boss Checked Into Motel One Day Before Body Was Found
sources.relevance: Reports motel staff observations and that no one heard gunfire.
